notes: Typical current price of a new product from public price listings. US dollars, before tax and shipping. The website calculator reads this file.

hdd.label: Seagate Exos X20 18 TB enterprise hard drive, new
hdd.watts_note: Between Seagate Exos X24 write (8.2 W) and read (9.8 W) power; surveillance recording is mostly writes.
hdd.market_median_note: Median of 68 new enterprise-drive offers on Amazon US (as of 2026-10-19).
hdd.annual_failure_rate_note: Backblaze lifetime annualized failure rate across about 353,000 drives, through June 30, 2026.
hdd.annual_failure_rate_formula: Annualized failure rate = drive failures / (drive days / 365) x 100 (Backblaze method, from real drives running 24x7).
hdd.manufacturer_afr_note: Seagate Exos X20 rating: 2.5 million hours MTBF = 0.35% AFR at full 24x7 use (AFR = 1 - e^(-8760 / MTBF)). Shown for comparison only; the calculator uses the real-world Backblaze rate.
hdd.service_life_note: Enterprise drives carry a 5-year warranty (Seagate Exos X20) and are planned for 3 to 5 years of 24x7 service. To keep video longer, every drive is replaced at the end of each 5-year life.

disk_enclosure.label: Supermicro 60-bay 4U disk enclosure (JBOD, 946SE1C-R1K66JBOD), new, empty
disk_enclosure.watts_note: Estimate for fans, expanders and power-supply losses, not counting the drives.

server.label: Dell PowerEdge R760xs 2U server, starting configuration
server.enclosures_note: One server runs up to 4 disk enclosures (240 drives). Both systems need at least one server; on the tape side it runs MARCIA/askALICE and the disk tier.

tape_library.label: HPE StoreEver MSL6480 tape library (80-slot modules)
tape_library.watts_note: HPE QuickSpecs maximum for the library; cartridges on the shelf use no power.
tape_library.source_name: LTO World (QU625A base module, QU626A expansion module); HPE QuickSpecs

lto.price_rule: price_usd is the midpoint of the low and high listed prices.
lto.cozaint_price_source: Cozaint price list (MSRP): COZLTO8MED $299, COZLTO9MED $349, COZLTO10AMED $599, COZLTO10BMED (LTO-10 40 TB) $729. Supplied by Omar, 2026-10-19.
lto.cozaint_note: Cozaint Certified cartridge prices set by Cozaint. When present, the calculator uses cozaint_cartridge_prices_usd for each LTO generation instead of the market price (cozaint_cartridge_price_usd is the LTO-9 price, kept for older copies of tco.js). Only a person changes these; the monthly agent never does.
lto.archival_life_note: LTO cartridges are designed for a 30-year archival life (Overland-Tandberg LTO media data sheet).

lto_drive.source_name: TapeBackup.org LTO tape price tracker (LTO-8, LTO-10); CCNY Tech (LTO-9 library drive kit)

cloud.source_name: Wasabi documentation: May 2026 Wasabi pricing notice and FAQs

cooling.label: Cooling, as a multiplier on equipment power (data center PUE)
cooling.note: Uptime Institute 2026 global survey average: every 1 watt of equipment needs about 0.52 watts more for cooling and building power.

tape_system.disk_tier_note: A small hard-drive tier holds the most recent video for instant playback; 10% of total storage, as in Cozaint's published storage white paper.

cozaint_software.note: Cozaint list price (MSRP). One copy per tape system. Only a person changes this; the monthly agent never does.
cozaint_software.source_name: Cozaint price list (MSRP), supplied by Omar 2026-10-19

cozaint_hardware.label: Cozaint MARCIA LTO library hardware and connectivity, MSRP
cozaint_hardware.note: Cozaint MSRP from the MARCIA reseller price list (effective October 2026). MSRP only; the reseller column is confidential and is never used here. Libraries are sold without drives. Only a person changes this section; the monthly agent never does.
cozaint_hardware.source_name: Cozaint MARCIA price list (MSRP), effective October 2026, supplied by Omar 2026-10-21

cozaint_services.note: MARCIA Media Lifecycle Renewal (MSRP): charged each time a cartridge is automatically erased, reinitialized and returned to recording after its retention cycle. Only a person changes this section; the monthly agent never does.
cozaint_services.source_name: Cozaint MARCIA price list (MSRP), effective October 2026

surveillance_systems.label: Complete video surveillance storage systems (recorders / video servers with drives), reseller prices
surveillance_systems.rule: The calculator uses the average price per TB of raw disk across these systems. Only complete systems with drives, a published US price and a stated capacity belong here; never a do-it-yourself build or a bare disk shelf.

systems.name: Hanwha Vision Wisenet WAVE WRR-P-S202L1 recorder

market_trend.summary: Hard drive prices keep edging up: DatacenterDisk's matched-model index shows enterprise drives about +2% over 30 days, with no relief expected before 2027 as AI data centers absorb supply. LTO cartridge prices stay roughly flat (about +0.5% over 30 days), and Wasabi's pay-as-you-go cloud price remains $7.99 per TB per month since July 1, 2026.
